qaRoadmap.introLead: This guide explains what you need to redeem a USALOCALSIM voucher and finish activation in this portal. Read the overview below, then open each step-by-step topic for full detail. You can return to Redeem at any time.
qaRoadmap.bullet1: Each voucher code is for your own use in this flow — keep it confidential until you type it into the official redeem page yourself.
qaRoadmap.bullet2: After you enter a valid code, we detect whether your product is a physical SIM voucher or an eSIM voucher so the right questions appear next.
qaRoadmap.bullet3: You will provide an email address and a travel date so we can schedule activation and send you updates.
qaRoadmap.bullet4: Later steps ask for device information: dial *#06# on your phone for IMEI (and EID for eSIM). Clear photos or careful typing both work.
qaRoadmap.warningBody: Do not share your voucher code, PIN, or photos of your *#06# screen or SIM card with anyone except official USALOCALSIM support when you contact us directly. Never post codes on social media or forums.
qaRoadmap.faq1Title: What you need before you start
qaRoadmap.faq1Body:
Have your voucher code ready (printed card, receipt, or email). Use an inbox you check regularly for the email field. Pick the real travel date you want service to align with.

You do not need to know “SIM vs eSIM” in advance — we detect it — but you should know whether you will photograph a physical SIM later (physical voucher) or only use on-screen numbers (often eSIM).
qaRoadmap.faq2Title: Where to find your voucher code
qaRoadmap.faq2Body: Look on the physical voucher or packaging, your point-of-sale receipt, or the purchase confirmation email from your retailer. The code may be labelled “PIN”, “voucher code”, or “activation code”. Enter it exactly; our field accepts uppercase automatically on the redeem page.
qaRoadmap.faq3Title: Physical SIM voucher — IMEI and SIM photo
qaRoadmap.faq3Body:
Dial *#06# on the handset that will use the service (or the one you are preparing for activation). You should see IMEI on screen.

Upload a sharp photo of that screen or type the IMEI carefully. We may also ask for a photo of the plastic SIM showing printed ICCID/numbers. JPEG or PNG under ~300 KB works best.
qaRoadmap.faq4Body:
Dial *#06# on a compatible phone. Both IMEI and EID are listed on that system screen.

You may upload one clear photo containing both values or type each value with care. Wrong IMEI/EID is a common reason for delays — double-check every digit.
qaRoadmap.faq5Body:
We use email for confirmations and operational messages about your request. The travel date helps our team schedule activation around your trip.

If either value is wrong, fix it before you submit the final steps; changing it later may require contacting support.
qaRoadmap.faq6Title: How redemption works in this portal
qaRoadmap.faq6Body:
1) Open Redeem and enter your code, then confirm with the Redeem button.
2) We validate the code and show whether it is physical SIM or eSIM.
3) Continue through contact and device-detail steps exactly as prompted.
4) Your request joins a processing queue — many activations are handled manually by our team, not instantly by a carrier API in every case.
qaRoadmap.faq7Body:
Status may show Scheduled or Processing until an administrator completes activation. You are not necessarily “live” on the network the same second you press submit.

Watch your email for next steps or confirmations. If nothing arrives within the timeframe promised at purchase, contact support with your order reference (not your public voucher code).
qaRoadmap.faq8Title: If validation fails or you see an error
qaRoadmap.faq8Body:
Remove accidental spaces, check you did not confuse letter O with zero, and confirm the voucher is meant for this international redeem portal (not another brand or region).

If it still fails, email support from the address on the site header and include proof of purchase — do not paste the full code publicly.
qaRoadmap.faq9Title: Gift cards vs USALOCALSIM service vouchers
qaRoadmap.faq9Body:
This site redeems USALOCALSIM service vouchers for travel SIM / eSIM activation. Generic retail “gift cards” or unrelated prepaid products cannot be substituted.

If you are unsure what you bought, check the retailer’s product name and email receipt before opening a support ticket.
